items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to stretch forth his hand toward heaven so that hail would fall upon all the land of Egypt, on man, beast, and every herb.
items.mechanism: Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven
